name: Melon Parker ~Kimi ga Nandemo-bu no Buchou-san!~
original_name: めろんぱーかー ～キミがなんでも部の部長さん！～
source:
"We are the Whatever Club!"

You and your five childhood friends,
Naroya, Samurai Sho, Soraneko, KAITO, and Kamome,
are members of the private Melonpan High School’s “Whatever Club”!

While cheerfully solving the incidents that happen at school and enjoying your high school life,
you suddenly get the chance to perform at a music festival!?

Can the “Whatever Club” succeed at the big stage of the music festival?

And where will your youthful story with the five of them lead...?

[Edited from [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/melon-parker-we-are-whatever-club-switch/]Nintendo[/url]]
translation:
“我们是任意俱乐部！”

你和你的五个儿时好友，
名罗也、武士翔、空猫、KAITO、海鸥，
是私立Melonpan高中“Whatever Club”的成员！

一边愉快地解决学校发生的事件，一边享受高中生活，
突然有机会在音乐节上表演！？

《Whatever Club》能否在音乐节这个大舞台上取得成功呢？

而你和他们五个人的青春故事又将走向何方……？

[编辑自[url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/melon-parker-we-are-whatever-club-switch/]Nintendo[/url]]
